name: Lin
title: Life system
motto: Write down your experiences. Find a rhythm that feels like you.
identity: Small experiments, shared along the way
Own the creative work; automate repetition
Life stories, creative experiments and one project

sections.title: Who I am
sections.description: Look for repeated behaviors in your own experiences. Replace these examples with your records.

cards.label: Curiosity
cards.title: Try a small experiment first
cards.body: Reserve a weekend for walking, noticing and making.
cards.action: Try a version you can finish in a day.

cards.label: Sharing
cards.title: Make it, then tell a friend
cards.body: Document the process and surprises, alongside the outcome.
cards.action: Write one step someone else can follow.

cards.label: Rhythm
cards.title: Protect an uninterrupted block
cards.body: A focused block, followed by time outdoors.
cards.action: Schedule rest too.

cards.label: Values
cards.title: Choose work you can sustain
cards.body: Consider how you feel after doing a project.
cards.action: Write down why you chose it.

sections.title: Clues to my strengths
sections.description: This is reflection, not a psychological assessment. Use behaviors, evidence and situations.

cards.label: Expression
cards.title: Explain a small discovery clearly
cards.body: Example evidence: a friend can reproduce your steps.
cards.action: Useful for tutorials, talks and introductions.

cards.label: Observation
cards.title: Notice everyday details
cards.body: Example evidence: notice three styles of shop signs on a walk.
cards.action: Useful for city stories, topics and design.

cards.label: Synthesis
cards.title: Turn scattered notes into one page
cards.body: Example evidence: turn travel notes into a map.
cards.action: Useful for checklists, templates and reflection.

sections.title: How I express myself
sections.description: Capture your own language habits without forcing a persona.

cards.label: Opening
cards.title: Start with a small moment
cards.body: On my walk today, I found a place that…
cards.action: Make the scene concrete.

cards.label: Process
cards.title: Show your process
cards.body: I tried this version first, then changed one thing.
cards.action: Show a comparison or a process screenshot.

cards.label: Ending
cards.title: Leave an actionable starting point
cards.body: You can start with one small note of your own.
cards.action: Offer a step, a template or an example.

sections.title: My boundaries
sections.description: Use your own criteria before turning every opportunity into a task.

cards.label: Time
cards.title: Keep some unscheduled time
cards.body: Check whether a last-minute task interrupts rest.
cards.action: Agree on a clear deadline.

cards.label: Scope
cards.title: One focus for this season
cards.body: Put new ideas on a list to try later.
cards.action: Decide at your next review.

cards.label: Collaboration
cards.title: Clarify deliverables and ownership
cards.body: Define what you own and what needs help.
cards.action: Align with a one-page brief.

sections.title: What I am working on
sections.description: Put life, creative work and projects on the same map.

cards.label: Life
cards.title: One city walk each week
cards.body: Record streets, food and people you meet.
cards.action: One page of walking notes each week.

cards.label: Creative work
cards.title: Make a weekend mini-zine
cards.body: Combine photos and notes into a shareable page.
cards.action: Start with a four-page version.

cards.label: Project
cards.title: Turn experience into a template
cards.body: Use examples you have actually tried.
cards.action: Ask one friend to try it.

sections.title: Where I get stuck
sections.description: Turn each obstacle into an adjustable action. Start with one.

cards.label: Starting
cards.title: Waiting for a perfect version
cards.body: Finish one page you can open.
cards.action: Make only the first page today.

cards.label: Switching
cards.title: Too many ideas split my attention
cards.body: Capture ideas, then choose once a week.
cards.action: Keep one active piece of work.

cards.label: Reviewing
cards.title: Forgetting to document the result
cards.body: Save a screenshot and three sentences when you finish.
cards.action: Record what you made, learned and will change.

sections.title: My operating rhythm
sections.description: Make a plan you can follow and adjust.

cards.label: Daily
cards.title: Finish one small thing
cards.body: Choose one action and make time for it.
cards.action: Write one discovery in the evening.

cards.label: Weekly
cards.title: Keep a weekly page
cards.body: Notice what gives energy and what needs less time.
cards.action: Choose one focus for next week.

cards.label: Monthly
cards.title: Revisit direction
cards.body: Decide what to continue and what to pause.
cards.action: Update this life-system page.

sections.title: What I could try next
sections.description: Choose one based on interest and capacity. No need to start everything.

cards.label: Green light
cards.title: Make a walking map
cards.body: Reuse your photos and route; share with a friend.
cards.action: Finishable in one weekend.

cards.label: Amber light
cards.title: Try a small talk
cards.body: Talk about one project you actually made.
cards.action: Check preparation time before committing.

cards.label: Red light
cards.title: Start three projects at once
cards.body: It may fragment your time.
cards.action: Keep it on the later list.
